opportunities.title: CSR/128 - The Civil Service Central Government Apprenticeship Training and Related Services Contract
opportunities.description: The Civil Service Apprenticeship Unit (CSAU) sits within the Cabinet Office (Authority) and is a centrally delivered support function for departments and suppliers for all aspects of apprenticeship training. The CSAU, on behalf of the Authority, sought to award contracts to certified apprenticeship training provider(s) who could deliver national or regional coverage of the services across the UK to Civil Service Departments. The CSAU, on behalf of the Authority, intended to award one contract to the highest-ranked tenderer for each National Lot and each Regional Sub-Lot (as described below). opportunities.title: Government Operational Research Specialist Level 7 Apprenticeship
opportunities.description: Government Operational Research Specialist (GORS) members from Other Government Departments and HMRC will receive Level 7 apprenticeship. The contract will be held in HMRC by the profession lead and other departments will order from it for cross government policy. Other government departments will order the number of apprentices required through the contract.

analysis.label: CareerPath Analysis
analysis.disclaimer: CareerPath analysis is our interpretation of published and observed market data. It is not an official government assessment.
insights: Procurement dates, values and delivery design should be treated as current public information and may change before contract award.
Geography, supply-chain requirements and workforce feasibility are likely to be as important as headline contract value for provider planning.
CareerPath separates published procurement facts from its own market interpretation so providers can see the evidence behind the intelligence.
